Thanks for the note and the materials. Quick update: our CTO, Priya Raman, is traveling June 1–3 and won't be available during the day on June 2. My CIO (Lena) can attend but she prefers a shorter, high-level slot focused on business impact rather than kernel-level detail.

2) Schedule a separate 20-minute technical hands-on with one of your engineers later that week for Priya's review (she usually prefers recorded short sessions + a follow-up Q&A).

I'll let Calendars propose the invite. If you need a named delegate, I'll confirm whether our VP Eng, Arun Varma, can cover the technical sponsor slot on short notice.
